title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
script:
42AI just raised sixty-two point five million dollars in funding.
The startup is building a world model that predicts human behavior.
Co-founder and CEO Amit Gal-Or leads this new venture.
Their software analyzes massive datasets to simulate complex human decision-making processes.
This technology aims to identify patterns in novel, real-world environments.
The firm is currently targeting applications in gaming, fraud prevention, and cybersecurity.
The model functions by learning how humans act in completely new situations.
Would you trust an AI to predict your next decision?

LINE 7: Replace 'The model' with 'The 42AI model' for better specificity.

line 6: Reusing the founders' photo here is redundant and breaks visual flow.
